title: Schematic netlist matches design.py
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/check_netlist.py
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS (every part, value, footprint, LCSC number and net as design.py says)

title: Datasheet pin gate (every assembled part's pins and every passive's value and rating)
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/check_pins.py
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS; no pin net changed since its review; no issue without a fix or waiver

title: ERC
procedure: kicad-cli sch erc --severity-all hardware/ref_design/board/battler.kicad_sch
pass_limit: 0 errors, 0 warnings

title: DRC with schematic parity

title: Backlight current-sink simulation (ngspice, vendor models)

pass_limit: phase margin >= 45 deg at every corner; DC <= 120 mA total; regulation within 5% from VSYS 3.5 V at Vf 3.2 V; off-state spike < 5 mA
evidence: last PASS b7a6238 2026-10-07 in hardware/ref_design/board/sim/backlight_results.txt, with no evidence header; backlight_circuit.py hard-codes its part values, so the run cannot follow design.py (DEF-45)

title: Board inside the case (check_fit)

pass_limit: RESULT: PASS, no collisions, every part under its local limit
evidence: last reported PASS at b2b9e27 (2026-10-19) in a commit message only, and case.scad has changed since: re-run and save fit_report.txt under hardware/vv/evidence/

title: Buttons work under the shell (check_buttons)

pass_limit: every check passes for both lids: pads clear the shell, caps sit and press without touching it, D-pad rocks 8 ways
evidence: last reported PASS at 269dc87 (2026-10-19) in a commit message only (shown then to fail on a cap that does not fit its slot): re-run and save the output under hardware/vv/evidence/

title: Contact footprint geometry, DSL_button_4ring (ref_design library)

pass_limit: min copper gap >= 0.20 mm; the worst bridging spot under half the measured Start/Select pill diameter everywhere; mask opening covers all copper

procedure: add an IPC-D-356 export to fab.py with each net-tie pair (JP1-JP5) merged into one net, or send no netlist; tick 'netlist test' on the order; keep JLC's e-test report

procedure: open battler_gerbers.zip in gerbv; compare each layer with kicad-cli renders; read the drill table and EP paste
pass_limit: every layer present and aligned; PTH/NPTH as intended; drills 0.3/0.6/0.65/2.2 mm only; EP paste 50-80%

title: JLC dry run: upload, parts match, placement preview, DFM report
procedure: upload gerbers, BOM and CPL at jlcpcb.com; stop before payment; screenshot every polarised part: U1, U2, U3, U4 (the dot), U6, U7, Q1-Q6, D2, D3, D5, D6, D7, L2, X1, J1, J2 (centroid), J3 (its pin-1 end); fill the order options checklist in the release record line by line
pass_limit: every LCSC line matched; every polarised part's pin 1 as the silk; J1 and J2 on their pads; DFM report clean; every order option as the checklist (edge rails no, order-number location specified, ENIG, 1.6 mm, 0.3 mm holes, confirm production file, netlist test, do not substitute)

title: CPL rotation table against JLC's library footprints
procedure: write board/tools/check_rotation.py: start from the kicad-jlcpcb-tools plugin's rotation correction table (footprint-name regex to angle) applied to fab.py's CPL; flag every polarised footprint with a nonzero correction (SOT-23, SOT-23-5, SOT-23-6, SOIC-8, QFN-80, SOD-123, SOD-323, FH12, PicoBlade); also list each assembled footprint's origin against its pads' bounding-box centre (pcbnew) and correct the CPL
pass_limit: 0 unexplained rotation offsets (U1/C13612 settled: DEF-14); every centroid offset over 0.1 mm corrected in the CPL or JLC's fix recorded (today J1 1.46 mm, J2 0.60 mm: DEF-33)

title: MLCC DC-bias derating, then re-run the unplug and hot-plug sims
procedure: table per CAP MPN from Samsung/Murata curves; feed derated values into VER-11 and VER-12
pass_limit: effective C at bias recorded for C1, C9, C5-C7, C24/C25, C34 and C3; both sims still meet their limits

title: Ratings and derating table per part and mode; 3V3 budget
procedure: extend pin_review ratings into one table: off, cell, USB, charging, hot plug, unplug; sum the 3V3 load
pass_limit: ICs: steady state at or below the recommended operating maximum and transients at least 0.3 V below the absolute maximum; passives and discretes: 80% (90% for transients under 10 us); every exception named in REQ-PWR-14; 3V3 load <= 150 mA; U3 <= 0.20 W

title: Charge-temperature window Monte Carlo (TH1, R39, R40, TP4056 thresholds)
procedure: write board/sim/temp_window.py: 1% resistors, TH1 +-1% R25 and B tolerance, TP4056 43-45% / 80-82%
pass_limit: 99.9% of units pause above 45 C +-3 C and below 0 C +-3 C (or the cell's own range)

title: Power latch state table: PWR_EN, pill resistance, leakage margins
procedure: write board/sim/latch.py: (Start, PWR_HOLD, VBUS) -> CE voltage with diode drops, R13/R15/R42, Q1 Vgs(th) up to its maximum in q1.json
pass_limit: on with 10 kohm of pill at VSYS 3.42 V (LDO dropout) with the margin to Q1's maximum threshold reported in volts; off with 1 Mohm leakage at 4.2 V; off after reset with E9 at 2.2 V

title: Application-circuit diff per IC and primary-source audit of inherited claims
procedure: for each IC: datasheet application circuit vs design.py, one line per difference with the reason
pass_limit: every difference explained; the four inherited claims (#196) cited or marked open

title: Datasheet archive with hashes
procedure: download every datasheet named in pin_review/*.json and SOURCES.md; record sha256 in hardware/vv/evidence/datasheets.txt
pass_limit: every reviewed part has a datasheet file whose sha256 is recorded (PDFs stay out of git)

title: Pin-review open questions and unknown ratings fail the gate
procedure: extend check_pins.py: read both rating schemas (what/limit and param/ds); fail on ok false or null without a 'waiver'; fail a passive whose rating_v < 1.25 x net_max_v or whose net_max_basis number differs from net_max_v; fail on 'OPEN QUESTION', 'UNKNOWN' or 'UNVERIFIED' text in an ok entry; print the lowest absolute maximum per rail (bringup.md's limits are checked against it by VER-161)
pass_limit: 0 open questions and 0 unknown ratings; today it must fail on 9 entries (d5 IFSM, panel VCI, panel VDDI, r47 overload, u2 BAT abs max, u2 CHRG/STDBY abs max, u3 CE pin, u3 output current, u3 dissipation): its acceptance test

title: Cell spec sheet: capacity, charge current, charge temperature, PCM values, size
procedure: get the MYWAY 403450 spec sheet; record it in hardware/vv/evidence/cell_403450.md and in board/cell.json (VER-160); recompute R5, REQ-PRD-03.R, REQ-PRD-04.R and REQ-BAT-02.R from it
pass_limit: capacity, standard charge current >= 364 mA, charge 0-45 C or tighter, OVP/UVP/OCP, 34 x 50 x 4.0 mm with PCM
needs: the 403450 spec sheet from the AliExpress vendor, by email, 7d (estimate)

title: Cell transport documents (UN38.3 test summary, MSDS)
procedure: ask the cell vendor for the UN38.3 test summary and MSDS of the exact model
pass_limit: both documents in hand for the cell model and lot
needs: UN38.3 summary and MSDS from the cell vendor, 14d (estimate)

title: Docs match the design (stale-doc sweep)
procedure: read README, PLAN, docs/*.md and the pin-review notes against design.py and case.scad; list each mismatch
pass_limit: 0 statements that disagree with design.py, case.scad or a check's output
evidence: hardware/vv/defects.md DEF-21 (eleven stale statements found while seeding this register)

title: Clean-room schematic review by a human who has not seen the notes
procedure: post the schematic PDF to r/PrintedCircuitBoard or EEVblog with no design notes; allow a week
pass_limit: replies read; every point answered in hardware/vv/evidence/cleanroom.md

title: Order-day stock, no substitution, pre-orders
procedure: JLC BOM page on order day; confirm RP2354B and L2 pre-ordered or consigned; 'do not substitute' on every line
pass_limit: stock >= quantity x 1.1 + attrition on every line; L2 and RP2354B are the designed parts
needs: RP2354B x35 and L2 (AOTA) x35 pre-ordered or consigned at JLC (both out of stock 2026-10-21), 21d (estimate)

title: Release record complete
procedure: hardware/vv/tools/release.py (VER-143) fills hardware/vv/releases/REL-<board>-R<rev>-<phase>.md from releases/TEMPLATE.md; Alex adds the JLC order number and JLC's returned placement file
pass_limit: tag, commit, design baseline, fab zip, BOM and CPL sha256, BOARD_REV, locked BOM, no-substitution list, order options checklist, capability page date, case section, gate output and waivers all filled

title: Real panel lit through a bottom-contact FPC breakout with design.py's J3 map
procedure: wire an ER-TFT035IPS-6 to an RP2350B dev board through a 0.5 mm 50-pin bottom-contact breakout using J3 pin j = panel 51-j; then time a full-screen redraw from the core's 320x480 RGB565 frame, expanded to 18-bit on the fly (PIO or DMA), and a battle-text update
pass_limit: backlight lights at 20 mA; ID4 reads 0x94 0x88; a colour fill shows no missing line; full redraw and text update within REQ-DSP-11's numbers with the frame in <= 320 KB
needs: ER-TFT035IPS-6 panel (BuyDisplay, 10d), 0.5 mm 50-pin bottom-contact breakout (7d), RP2350B dev board (about $10, 7d)

title: Panel FPC tail thickness and width against the FH12-50S
procedure: calipers (about $15 if not owned) on the stiffened tail at three points
needs: calipers (about $15, 2d) and the panel (VER-43)

title: Comb pill resistance on ENIG, on a bare board from the order
procedure: a bare board from the same JLC order (same ENIG bath and mask), on day one before any assembled unit is powered; press a DS Lite pill with a 1 N weight on every contact; DMM ohms (a $2 coupon ordered now is advisory only)
pass_limit: < 1 kohm on every contact, 10 presses each
needs: the 5 bare boards from the JLC order, 14d

title: Comb leakage at 4.2 V, clean and after humidity
procedure: on the same bare board: 4.2 V from the bench supply through the comb into a DMM on volts (10 Mohm input); read the leakage from the divider
pass_limit: >= 100 Mohm (DMM reads <= 0.38 V) clean, after a damp-cloth wipe and after 24 h in a sealed box with a wet sponge
needs: the 5 bare boards from the JLC order, 14d

title: Latch replica on SOT-23 breakouts (disputed: Fable only)
procedure: build Q1, D2, D3, R13-R15, R42, U3 from the real LCSC parts; drive PWR_HOLD from a Pico 2 through a watchdog reset
pass_limit: holds and releases at VSYS 3.5 and 4.2 V; starts with 1 kohm in series with the button
evidence: superseded by VER-33 (latch.py) before the order and VER-70, VER-73, VER-77, VER-78 on unit 1; every latch part reworks on an EVT unit and USB bypasses the latch for bring-up (O-10, F-32); G-ORD-06 needs Alex's waiver W-01

title: Printed case with real parts: fit, snap, screws, caps, panel in the lid
procedure: print the released case (VER-173 names its STL hashes, material and slicer profile); fit the board, cell, speaker, silicone, caps and panel; close with the six screws
pass_limit: closes without force; caps 1.85 +-0.2 mm proud and free; panel window aligned within 0.5 mm; nothing rattles; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Cell incoming inspection per lot
procedure: every cell: DMM on the plug (red lead on J2 pin 1 '+'), OCV; the plug latches in a Molex 53261-0271 sample and withdraws only with the latch pressed; one per lot: calipers with its PCM
pass_limit: 100% polarity correct; 100% of plugs latch; OCV 3.6-4.0 V as shipped; size within 34 x 50 x 4.0 mm +0.3
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d) and one 53261-0271 sample (LCSC, $0.13, 7d)

title: Button force and travel against a genuine DS Lite
procedure: kitchen scale (0.1 g) under the cap, press until the pill closes (DMM continuity); depth gauge or calipers for travel
pass_limit: force within +-30% of the genuine DS Lite measured the same way; travel within +-0.2 mm
needs: a printed case (VER-48) and a genuine DS Lite (owned), 0d

title: Pill-to-comb XY registration measured on the fit kit
procedure: ink the pills, press each button once on the board mock, measure the print against the comb centre (loupe, calipers)
pass_limit: every pill print centred within 0.9 mm of its comb centre

title: BU-0 unpowered resistances to GND (TP1-TP4) and VBUS-VBAT
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM)
pass_limit: TP1 about 0.8-1.0 kohm (R38 1k in parallel with the TEMP divider and the D5/D6 paths), TP2-TP4 > 1 kohm once the caps charge (TP3 above 1 kohm also rules out a U2 pin 5 to EP bridge: DF-106), TP1-TP3 > 10 kohm; none a short

title: BU-0 diode tests VBAT<->VSYS and VBUS<->VSYS
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM diode range)
pass_limit: TP3(+) to TP2: 0.15-0.35 V (D7 in parallel with Q2's body diode); TP2(+) to TP3: open; TP1(+) to TP2: 0.15-0.35 V (D5 through R47); TP2(+) to TP1: open. bringup.md today says one body-diode drop: wrong (DEF-21)

title: BU-0 cell polarity at J2 before mating
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0; hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 2
pass_limit: red lead on J2 pin 1 '+', checked with a DMM, every cell
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d)

title: BU-1 USB only, no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 1: first power from the bench supply at 5.0 V with a 100 mA limit through a USB-C breakout, never a wall charger first (DF-101); USB power meter
pass_limit: VBUS 4.75-5.25 V; VSYS 4.5-4.7 V; 3V3 3.20-3.40 V; input < 60 mA (a blank RP2354B in BOOTSEL, R38, the TEMP divider and U2 pulsing into C3); RP2350 drive appears within 5 s
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d)

title: BU-2.1 all 20 buttons read, alone and together
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.1 with the self-test image
pass_limit: each contact reads pressed when its combs are shorted and released otherwise; any 4 at once read correctly

title: BU-2.2/2.3 ADC7 and charger status pins
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md steps 2.2-2.3
pass_limit: ADC7 reads; CHG_STAT_N and CHG_DONE_N read with pull-downs off

title: BU-2.4 SWD through J5 and J7, UART through J6
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.4
pass_limit: probe-rs attaches through J5 and J7; UART text at 115200 8N1 through J6 with the Debug Probe cable

title: BU-2.5 revision strap
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.5
pass_limit: REV3..REV0 = BOARD_REV (1) with pull-ups on

title: BU-3.1-3.3 panel init, ID, colour
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display steps 1-3
pass_limit: ID4 = 0x94 0x88 at <= 5 MHz; red, green, blue, white fills correct, no missing lines

title: BU-3.4 SPI write speed
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 4
pass_limit: 10 full frames of a checker pattern at 20 MHz with 0 corrupted pixels at the far edge

title: BU-3.5 backlight current, balance, step response, headroom
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 5; first light with JP2 cut and a DMM on mA across it
pass_limit: 80%: 99 +-5 mV on R52 and R53, within 3 mV of each other; at the firmware's maximum duty: <= 120 mA total; at its minimum duty: the halves within 20%; 18<->95% step: no ringing on the scope; 3.5 V cell at the maximum duty: drop <= 5%

title: BU-3.6 tearing-effect pulse
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 6
pass_limit: one pulse per frame, 60 Hz +-10%

title: BU-4 audio: level, carrier, wake, heat, noise
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 4; scope across SPK_P/SPK_N (two probes, A-B); thermocouple on U7
pass_limit: >= 0.35 W into 8 ohm (>= 4.75 V peak-to-peak) at 1 kHz on a 3.8 V cell; carrier >= 40 dB down; full output <= 150 ms after AMP_EN; U7 top <= 85 C after 10 min full scale on USB; no audible whine in silence

title: BU-5.1 off-state cell current
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.1: DMM across cut JP5 on its A range through turn-on, then the uA range with the device off (or a 0.1 ohm shunt on the scope); the uA range cannot pass the 0.75 A turn-on peak; with VER-146's TP1 reading
pass_limit: <= 30 uA at 25 C, cell 3.7-4.2 V, device off, no USB

title: BU-5.2 charge current and CHG_OFF pause
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.2: DMM on its A range across cut JP5; log the current for 10 min at the start of CC with a thermocouple on U2's top (a voided exposed pad shows the current sliding as U2 passes 70 C: DF-08)
pass_limit: 300-400 mA into a cell at 3.6-3.9 V and still >= 300 mA after 10 min with U2's top under ambient + 60 C; CHG_OFF high stops it within 1 s; low resumes

title: BU-5.3 ADC against a meter; CV at charge-done; bench-supply sweep
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.3; then the bench supply in place of the cell, 3.0-4.2 V in 0.1 V steps, with CHG_OFF (GPIO19, Q4) held high or 10 ohm 5 W across the supply (most supplies cannot sink the TP4056's 333-364 mA, so the 'cell' would climb toward 4.2 V); record VBAT at each point
pass_limit: computed VBAT within 20 mV of the DMM at 3.50 V after calibration (VER-155) and within 50 mV elsewhere above 3.6 V; VBAT 4.158-4.242 V at CHG_DONE_N low
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference that session
needs: 10 ohm 5 W resistor and a 4.096 V reference breakout (LM4040 or REF3040, about $3, 7d)

title: BU-5.4 charger heat and TEMP level
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4 (thermocouple on U2)
pass_limit: TEMP = 0.63 +-0.03 x VBUS at 25 C; still >= 0.50 x VBUS after 10 min of charging in the closed case

title: BU-5.4a charge pauses outside the temperature window
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4a on unit 1 only (hair dryer, cold pack, thermocouple next to TH1); VER-135 is the per-unit TEMP check
pass_limit: pauses at 45 +-3 C rising and at 0 +-3 C falling; resumes in range

title: BU-5.5 unplug hand-over on the scope; 100 unplugs with a flash check
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.5; scope on TP4, TP2 and TP7 (LS_GATE); the bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V with CHG_OFF held high or 10 ohm 5 W across it, so it stays at 3.50 V while USB is in; record VBAT at the trigger instant
pass_limit: VBAT at the trigger 3.50 +-0.03 V; 3V3 >= 2.97 V throughout (minimum recorded against 3.135 V); Q2 on within 5 ms; 100 unplugs with no reset and no flash CRC error

title: BU-5.6 hot plug with no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.6 (A-to-C cable from an always-on USB-A port)
pass_limit: VBUS <= 7.7 V; VSYS <= 5.7 V (bringup.md says 6.5 V, which ignores the FM8002A's 6.0 V: DEF-06)

title: BU-5.7 ME6211 CE at a live plug-in
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.7 (scope TP6 and TP2, math TP6-TP2)
pass_limit: PWR_EN - VSYS <= +0.3 V at every instant, 10 plug-ins

title: BU-6 power switch: on, latch, off, reset
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 6 (bringup.md 6.2-6.3 still say Y: DEF-21)
pass_limit: on only after Start held 1.0 +-0.2 s; off after a long press; RESET turns it off on the cell; off current back <= 30 uA

title: First power with JP1 cut (catch a wrong LDO before it reaches the chip)
procedure: add to bringup.md step 1: unit 1 with JP1 cut, USB through a 100 mA limit, DMM on 3V3_LDO; then bridge JP1
pass_limit: 3V3_LDO 3.20-3.40 V before JP1 is bridged

title: Chip identity and stepping, logged per unit
procedure: picotool info -a (chip ID, package, stepping, flash JEDEC ID) at first boot; write it to the unit's record
pass_limit: RP2354B, 2 MB flash; stepping recorded (A2 means E9 applies to AMP_EN and BL_PWM)

title: Production self-test image
procedure: write a self-test UF2 on the generated pin file (VER-149): buttons; a GPIO neighbour-bridge test whose pair table is generated from design.GPIO_PIN, marking each pin safe to toggle or not (PWR_HOLD, CHG_OFF, AMP_EN, BL_PWM, the QSPI pins), using the external pull's direction where one exists, on USB power only, and cross-checked against hardware/vv/bridges.csv (VER-148); panel ID and fills; backlight; audio tone; ADC; charger states incl. blinking; REV strap; no OTP or flash-security writes
pass_limit: every item PASS on a good unit and FAIL on a seeded fault (a shorted button, a panel unplugged); every 'caught by self-test' pair in bridges.csv is in its pair table; <= 5 min a unit

title: PWR_HOLD release after reset and crash on the real board
procedure: scope GPIO2 (PWR_HOLD) and TP6 through RESET, a watchdog reset and a hard fault, on the cell
pass_limit: PWR_HOLD < 0.5 V within 10 ms; 3V3 < 0.5 V within 200 ms of Start released

title: Start with 1 kohm in series still turns the device on
procedure: 10 kohm across SW21's combs instead of the pill; bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V
pass_limit: 3V3 >= 3.20 V within 50 ms; PWR_BTN_N reads low; Q1's gate margin over its maximum Vgs(th) (q1.json) reported in volts

title: Start leakage immunity and per-unit comb leakage
procedure: 1 Mohm across SW21's combs, cell at 4.2 V, no USB; then each unit's SW21 leakage as VER-46
pass_limit: the device stays off (3V3 < 0.5 V) for 10 min; every unit's SW21 >= 100 Mohm

title: USB sources, cables and orientations
procedure: both plug orientations on a USB-C charger, a PD charger, an A-to-C cable from a PC and from a hub, the bench supply at a 500 mA limit; 5 cables. Characterisation (recorded, not pass/fail: REQ-PWR-01, REQ-PWR-16): bench supply into VBUS through a USB-C breakout at 4.40 V and 4.60 V, backlight full, DMM across cut JP5 at CV: whether CHG_DONE_N goes low and how much current D7 carries (DF-99)
pass_limit: charges and enumerates in both orientations on every source; no limit cycling at 500 mA; every cable seats fully, case closed
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d) and a PD charger (owned?)

title: Input current from a default-power USB port
procedure: USB power meter between a PC's USB-A port and the device, charging a flat cell with the backlight at 100%
pass_limit: <= 500 mA within 2 s of plug-in once firmware has read CC (the decision on legacy hosts is open: REQ-PWR-12)

title: Charge path after charge-done plus 1 h (unit 1 confirmation)
procedure: unit 1, after VER-133 and VER-169 pass: with USB in, after charge-done plus 1 h, DMM on TP3
pass_limit: VBAT <= 4.25 V after 1 h at charge-done (VER-133 and VER-169 are the per-unit screens)

title: 3V3 regulation and 3V3 load
procedure: bench supply into VBUS (USB-C breakout) and as the cell 3.6-4.2 V; DMM on mA across cut JP1 at idle and at the self-test's heaviest load
pass_limit: 3V3 3.20-3.40 V at every point; 3V3 load <= 150 mA

title: 1V1 core rail level and ripple
procedure: scope on TP9 (1V1), 20 MHz limit, ground spring, at idle and at full CPU load
pass_limit: within the RP2350's DVDD range (Table 1688: write the values into this row on first use) including ripple

title: Cell surface temperature over a full charge in the closed case
procedure: attended, in a LiPo bag on a tile (VER-172); K-type thermocouple taped to the cell (a DMM with a thermocouple input, about $25 if not owned); log every minute; 25 C room, then a 35 C box
pass_limit: <= 45 C at 25 C ambient; <= the cell maker's charge maximum at 35 C
needs: DMM with thermocouple input (about $25, 2d)

title: Touch temperature during charge-while-playing
procedure: the firmware rule from VER-144 in the image first; thermocouples on the lid face over U2, the back over U7 and the hottest spot found by touch; 1 h charge-while-playing, backlight 100%, audio full scale
pass_limit: <= 43 C (target) at 25 C ambient; measured rise + the rated maximum ambient <= 48 C (IEC 62368-1 TS1 limit for plastic held 10 min to 8 h)

title: TH1 tracks the cell during charge
procedure: two thermocouples: one at the cell's centre and one on its edge under TH1; TH1 from the TEMP voltage (VER-68); one full charge in the closed case
pass_limit: TH1 within 5 C of the cell's hotter point throughout
needs: a second thermocouple (about $3, 7d)

title: Cell protection (PCM) trip test on a spare pack
procedure: bench supply into the pack: raise to find OVP, discharge through a resistor to find UVP, short through 0.1 ohm for OCP
pass_limit: OVP 4.25-4.35 V; UVP 2.4-3.0 V; OCP trips (or the spec sheet's values) on one pack per lot

title: Assembled-board inspection under the microscope (IPC-A-610 Class 2)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 3.2 extended: QFN-80 edges, U2's exposed-pad edges (pins 4 and 5), ESOP and SOT leads, 0402s, J1's pin row, J3's pins, every polarised mark against the silk
pass_limit: no bridge, tombstone, lifted lead or missing part; every pin 1 as the silk; every unit

title: Board flatness on arrival
procedure: board on a glass plate, feeler gauges (about $5) at the corners
pass_limit: bow and twist <= 0.75% (1.1 mm over 151 mm)

title: Hand assembly demo and time study
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md sections 3-5 on one unit, timed, ESD mat and strap (about $15); record the step order: the speaker soldered on the bare board, the iron cold before the cell goes in, the FPC latched before the cell is plugged, the cell plugged last (DEF-41)
pass_limit: one unit in <= 30 min with an iron, a screwdriver and a knife; no part damaged; no hot work and no connector mating with the cell connected; cell and panel each swap in <= 10 min
needs: ESD mat and strap (about $15, 2d)

title: Case open/close cycling
procedure: 20 open/close cycles with the six screws at the length VER-147 sets, as assembly.md step 8; the case closed with the cell unplugged; after the cycles: C9 at 40x and TP2 to GND re-measured
pass_limit: no cracked hook and no stripped boss; lid still seats; C9 uncracked and TP2 > 1 kohm; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Drop test
procedure: unit 4 (sacrificial, gates.md allocation): 3 drops from 1.0 m onto hardwood on the face, an end and a corner (IEC 62368-1 Annex T.7, to confirm); re-run on the DVT spin when a change record asks
pass_limit: still works; no crack that exposes the cell or a board; cell moved <= 1 mm; plug and FPC still seated

title: Button life cycling
procedure: unit 4 or a bare board in a printed case: a hobby servo and a Pico press one button of each type (about $10 of parts)
pass_limit: 100,000 presses with contact resistance staying < 1 kohm
needs: hobby servo and a Pico (about $10, 7d)

title: ESD screen on unit 4 (piezo igniter)
procedure: unit 4: a piezo lighter igniter (about $3, uncalibrated, about 10 kV) at each cap gap (comb pads first), the seams and the USB-C shell, 10 zaps each; the calibrated test is VER-170 on the DVT spin
pass_limit: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle; any dead input or latch-up named for the DVT fix (0402 series-resistor footprints on the button nets and SW21)
needs: piezo lighter igniter (about $3, 2d)

title: Near-field emissions pre-scan
procedure: unit 4 or 2: H-field probe set (about $25, or a loop of coax) on the scope's FFT over the board, case open and closed
pass_limit: the five largest peaks named with their source; none from a net that should be quiet
needs: H-field probe set (about $25, 7d)

title: Margins and abuse on a sacrificial board
procedure: unit 4 (sacrificial): VBUS 4.0-6.0 V; cell emulation 2.8-4.3 V; 0-45 C by fridge and warm box; shorted speaker; panel unplugged hot; reversed cell through a 0.5 A limit
pass_limit: no damage inside the rated range; outside it, failure is safe (no heat above 60 C, no smoke)

title: DFMEA review
procedure: Alex and two independent models read dfmea.csv; every S >= 9 row lists its layers of protection
pass_limit: every row reviewed; every H row has an action, a passing detection or an acceptance; reviewers named

title: USB VBUS capacitance and inrush
procedure: from design.py: the capacitance on VBUS and the capacitance the plug-in charges through D5 with no cell (VSYS and, through JP3, AMP_VDD); Q = C x V against USB 2.0 cl. 7.2.4.1
pass_limit: VBUS capacitance <= 10 uF; the plug-in charge with no cell computed and written into REQ-PWR-13; any excess over USB 2.0's 50 uC carried as REQ-PWR-13's written deviation

title: Audio chain simulation (filter, coupling, FM8002A input)
procedure: not in the repo: the ngspice filter run quoted in validation_plan #40/#153; commit it under board/sim/
pass_limit: -3 dB >= 10 kHz; low corner <= 50 Hz; carrier at 586 kHz >= 40 dB down

title: Play time from full to cutoff
procedure: self-test image's soak mode: 50% backlight, a tune at -12 dBFS; log VBAT over the UART every minute
pass_limit: >= 4 h from charge-done to the 3.50 V cutoff at 25 C

title: Charge time from cutoff to done
procedure: from the 3.50 V cutoff, charger only (backlight off); log CHG pins and time
pass_limit: <= 3.0 h to CHG_DONE_N low at 25 C from a source offering >= 1.5 A

title: Shelf and deep-discharge estimate
procedure: spreadsheet: off current (VER-65, and at 45 C from VER-146) plus the PCM's own drain (3-6 uA, which never passes JP5: from VER-37) plus the cell's self-discharge (1-3% a month) against the capacity between the cutoff and the PCM's UVP (VER-153)
pass_limit: >= 2 months from the cutoff to the PCM's UVP at 25 C and at 45 C storage; >= 2 years from full (or the numbers Alex sets knowing both terms)

title: Watchdog rule written down
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/pinmap.md, Power control
pass_limit: the rule 'enable the watchdog before any blocking init' is written in the pin map
evidence: hardware/ref_design/docs/pinmap.md (Power control: 'Enable the watchdog before any blocking init')

title: Hang test on the self-test image
procedure: a self-test command that hangs with PWR_HOLD high, on the cell
pass_limit: the device is off within 10 s (watchdog reset releases PWR_HOLD)

title: Panel FPC fold and ZIF retention
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md step 4; then the display test after 10 lid closures
pass_limit: FPC fully in, square, latch shut; 0.5-3 mm slack; display test passes after 10 closures

title: Recovery through the pinholes, case closed
procedure: case closed: BOOTSEL + RESET through the pinholes with a 1 mm pin enters the USB boot loader; repeat with a flat cell on USB
pass_limit: boot loader drive appears both times

title: USB D+/D- stub and pair length
procedure: write board/tools/check_usb.py (pcbnew)
pass_limit: stubs <= 3.5 mm (pin_review/j1.json); D+/D- length mismatch <= 2 mm

title: First article inspection (AS9102 style) per lot
procedure: fill the sheet fai_sheet.py writes (VER-166) on unit 1: every BOM line present, marking, orientation (J3's pin-1 end, U4's dot), key dimensions, the cell leads' sleeving where they pass the board's hole
pass_limit: every characteristic recorded and within limits before the rest of the lot is powered; the checker accepts the sheet

title: Per-unit production record with serial
procedure: serial on the board's back; hardware/vv/evidence/units.csv (one row a unit: release, chip ID and stepping, cell lot, VBAT gain, mating counts for J2, J3, J5, J6, allocation, self-test log, golden flags) and hardware/vv/evidence/findings.csv (one row a finding: serial, finding, found by FAI, bring-up or self-test, disposition rework, scrap or use as is, re-test done)
pass_limit: every unit has a complete row; every reworked unit re-tested; any finding on 2 units raised as a DEF with a check

title: First-pass yield record
procedure: count of units passing VER-76 first time; a DEF entry per failure
pass_limit: >= 90% first-pass yield; every failure explained

title: Part heights from drawings, not guesses (check_fit truth)
procedure: fill check_fit's KNOWN_HEIGHT from each MPN's drawing; make an unknown package a failure, not a 1.5 mm default
pass_limit: every part's height cited; 0 parts on PACKAGE_HEIGHT guesses

title: No unintended openings through the lid or tub
procedure: write case/check_openings.py: compare the printed parts' through-holes with the intended list (another branch has check_manifold.py)
pass_limit: 0 through-openings other than the listed ones

title: Every drilled hole >= 0.30 mm
procedure: read both drill files from fab.py (VER-131 parses them)
pass_limit: smallest hole >= 0.30 mm

title: Test-point coverage for every bring-up measurement
procedure: cross-reference every quantity in bringup.md with TP1-TP16, jumper pads and named part pads
pass_limit: every measurement has a probe point reachable on the bench

title: Bench gear matrix
procedure: list each check's gear and parts in the 'needs' column; python3 hardware/vv/tools/check_trace.py --shopping prints them by lead time; include the 4.096 V reference (F-38), clip leads (F-52), a LiPo bag (F-43), two thermocouples (DF-04), the piezo igniter, a USB-C breakout, PicoBlade saver pigtails
pass_limit: every T/I check runs on owned or listed gear; buys with a lead time placed before the boards arrive

title: Cost re-quote after the latest changes
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/cost.py; JLC and PCBWay instant quotes (hardware/ref_design/tools/quotes)
pass_limit: <= $45 a unit at 10, all in

title: Emissions at a test house
procedure: FCC Part 15 Class B / CISPR 32 Class B radiated and conducted
pass_limit: pass with >= 3 dB margin

title: prod_board: contacts where prod_case says
procedure: write a checker beside place_buttons.py: each SW footprint against layout.scad's echo block
pass_limit: every contact within 0.05 mm of its layout.scad position

title: prod_board: ERC
procedure: kicad-cli sch erc hardware/prod_board/prod_board/prod_board.kicad_sch
pass_limit: 0 errors (the schematic is empty at 76955d2)

title: prod_board: DRC with schematic parity
procedure: kicad-cli pcb drc --schematic-parity hardware/prod_board/prod_board/prod_board.kicad_pcb
pass_limit: 0 errors, 0 unconnected, 0 parity

title: prod_board: board inside prod_case
procedure: a fit check for prod_case (none exists)
pass_limit: no collisions

title: Perfboard power path (advisory, Opus only)
procedure: the $20 perfboard of U2, D5, D7, Q2, D6, U3 from validation_plan section 4; skip if not built
pass_limit: 3V3 never under 2.97 V on 20 unplugs at a 3.5 V cell
evidence: superseded: the unplug depends on layout parasitics and C9's DC bias, which a perfboard does not reproduce; VER-11 before the order and VER-70 on unit 1 instead (O-10, F-32); G-ORD-13 needs Alex's waiver W-02

title: FM8002A SHUTDOWN polarity from C94625's own datasheet
procedure: hardware/ref_design/board/pin_review/u7.json pin 1
pass_limit: active high: SHUTDOWN at VDD = off, 0 V = on; matches R36/Q3

title: Footprints against the manufacturers' land patterns
procedure: write board/tools/check_land.py (pcbnew pad dump vs each drawing or the EasyEDA footprint); SOT pin numbering by hand for D2, Q1, Q2, U3, D3, D6
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences in pad count, pitch, pin 1 and EP size

title: Incoming inspection of panels, silicone and caps per lot
procedure: per lot: one panel against its drawing and lit on the breakout; silicone and caps against case/DSLITE.md numbers
pass_limit: outline within the drawing's tolerance; pad and cap sizes within +-0.1 mm of the numbers case.scad uses
needs: a panel, silicone and caps per lot (AliExpress, 21d)

title: Off state with the Debug Probe attached
procedure: the path table is VER-159; on unit 1 measure 3V3 and the off current with the Debug Probe attached to J5 and J6 and USB out
pass_limit: 3V3 < 0.5 V and off current <= 30 uA with the probe attached and USB out

title: Speaker chosen and measured
procedure: pick the 15 mm 8 ohm speaker; read its rated power from the listing; calipers and DMM on two samples
pass_limit: diameter 15.0 +-0.3 mm, thickness <= 4.0 mm, 8 ohm +-15%, leads reach J4; rated power >= 0.6 W, or the firmware caps full scale to the rating (DF-49)
needs: two speaker samples (AliExpress, 21d)

title: Seeded faults: check_trace.py fails on each structural fault
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/seed_faults.py: copies hardware/vv to a scratch directory, applies one fault at a time, runs check_trace.py --vv on the copy
pass_limit: the clean copy exits 0; every seeded fault exits 1 with its expected message; a non-ancestor commit shows as stale

title: BOM, CPL and PCB fields against design.py (check_bom_cpl.py)
procedure: write board/tools/check_bom_cpl.py, run inside fab.py before zipping and in scripts/check.sh: (1) design.PARTS against battler.kicad_pcb's footprints (Reference, Value, LCSC, footprint id, layer); (2) battler_bom_jlc.csv and battler_cpl_jlc.csv against design.PARTS: every bom=True ref exactly once, LCSC present, top side only, no DNP or unassembled ref (R48, C41-C43, JP1-JP5, TP1-TP16, SW1-SW23, J4, J7), no build_pcb.NO_ASSEMBLY ref; (3) totals against assembly.md
pass_limit: 0 differences; 49 BOM lines and 117 placements, or whatever assembly.md states, which must agree; exit 1 otherwise

title: Drill files: PTH and NPTH apart, holes as designed
procedure: add --excellon-separate-th to fab.py's drill export (today one MixedPlating file: DEF-32); parse both Excellon files
pass_limit: NPTH file: exactly 8 holes (6 x 2.2 mm for H1-H6, 2 x 0.65 mm for J1's pegs); PTH file: no hole under 0.30 mm; 4 G85 slots at J1's shell; no MixedPlating file

title: Fab file content (check_fab_content.py, reusing membrane/tools/gerb.py)
procedure: over board/fab/: (a) every Excellon tool >= 0.30 mm; (b) no F.Paste aperture and no silk inside any comb's 4.8 mm circle, F.Mask opening >= 4.8 mm at each of the 20 contact centres; (c) copper under every CPL centroid on F.Cu; (d) BOM and CPL counts as VER-130; (e) no copper within 0.30 mm of Edge.Cuts except J1's pads; (f) B.Paste empty (J4's Speaker_Wire pads kept out of paste, or the JLC note written); (g) all 9 layers, both drill files and the job file present, Edge.Cuts closed with the cell-plug cutout; (h) no aux_axis_origin in the pcb (or one origin flag for all three exports) and every Excellon hole on a pad or via centre in the copper
pass_limit: 0 violations on every item; exit 1 otherwise; output saved as evidence

title: Per-unit charge-path screen with USB in and no cell
procedure: bringup.md step 1 (to be added) and the production test, before any cell touches the unit: USB from the bench supply at 5.0 V with a 100 mA limit through a USB-C breakout; DMM on TP1 (VBUS), TP2 (VSYS), TP3 (VBAT), TP7 (LS_GATE); clip leads only (DF-116)
pass_limit: TP3 <= 4.25 V; TP2 - TP3 >= 0.3 V; TP7 >= TP1 - 0.4 V; every unit
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d) and a clip-lead set (about $8, 2d)

title: Per-unit CV with an 82 ohm load in place of the cell
procedure: a PicoBlade pigtail (on the saver, VER-157) with 82 ohm 0.5 W across J2; USB in; read TP3 within 30 s
pass_limit: TP3 4.158-4.242 V (51 mA keeps U2 in CV, above its 36 mA C/10 termination); every unit
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference that session
needs: 82 ohm 0.5 W resistor and a PicoBlade pigtail pair (about $2, LCSC, 7d)

title: Per-unit TEMP window by resistors
procedure: USB in, the VER-134 load fitted: press 6.8 kohm across C41's DNP 1206 pads (CHG_TEMP to GND: 9.375k || 6.8k gives 0.41 x VBUS); then hold 2.7 kohm across R39 (5.6k || 2.7k gives 0.84 x VBUS); then remove it
pass_limit: with 6.8k: CHG_STAT_N and CHG_DONE_N both high (paused); with 2.7k: both high; removed: CHG_STAT_N low again within 2 s; TEMP 0.63 +-0.03 x VBUS before and after; every unit
needs: 6.8k and 2.7k resistors (about $1, 7d)

title: J3 map and the FPC fold with the real panel, unpowered
procedure: a loose FH12-50S breakout on the fit-kit board mock in J3's position and orientation; insert the FPC as assembly.md section 5 step 4 (panel face down, contacts down), fold the panel over; DMM diode test from breakout pin 50 (+) to pins 49 and 48; continuity among breakout pins 1, 2, 3 and 8
pass_limit: pin 50 to 49 and to 48: 2.5-3.0 V forward with the LEDs glowing faintly, open when reversed; pins 1, 2, 3 and 8 joined (panel GND pins 50, 49, 48, 43)
needs: FH12-50S breakout (about $5, 7d) and the panel (VER-43)

title: Backlight worst-case tolerance sweep (backlight_tol.py)
procedure: write board/sim/backlight_tol.py reading design.py: min/max over 3V3 +-2%, R60/R61 +-1%, R52/R53 +-1%, U6 offset +-4.5 mV, LED Vf 2.8-3.4 V, VSYS 3.5-5.7 V, duty from the firmware's minimum to its maximum
pass_limit: at the firmware's maximum duty: <= 120 mA total at every corner (about 122.5 mA at 100% today: cap the duty at 95% or R61 3.6k); at Vf 3.4 V and VSYS 3.5 V the drop stated (about -6.3%, 52.5 mA a pin, loop open); the two halves within 20% at the minimum duty

title: Cutoff accuracy analysis: the calibrated reading against the true cell voltage
procedure: write board/sim/cutoff.py: the firmware's VBAT reading (3V3 as the ADC reference, R17/R18 1%, the stored gain) against the true VBAT 3.0-3.7 V, with Vreg +-2%, CV +-1% or VER-155's bench calibration, and Vd (LDO dropout, Q2 and copper) at the highest 3V3 load
pass_limit: the cutoff acts at a true 3.50 V +0.05/-0.00 V at every corner; any corner with Vreg + Vd > 3.50 x CV/4.2 (the reading stops falling, so the cutoff never fires) fails

title: Cutoff bench sweep without USB
procedure: no USB; bench supply into J2 through the saver (it only sources here), 3.7 V down to 3.0 V in 20 mV steps; self-test at full CPU and panel load; firmware VBAT on the UART against a DMM on TP3; on the unit with the highest TP4 (3V3) reading
pass_limit: the firmware shuts down at a true 3.50-3.55 V; its reading falls at every step down to the cutoff
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference

title: Cell mating peak against the PCM's short-circuit trip
procedure: from design.py: with no USB, R6 holds Q2 on, so plugging the cell charges C3 and, through Q2, C2, C9, C5 and C34 (through JP3), about 47 uF; series path (cell ESR, PCM FETs, leads, Q2) 0.25-0.35 ohm; compare the peak (about 12-17 A, tau about 14 us) with the PCM's short-circuit threshold and delay (VER-37) and J2's rating; and the VSYS edge through Q1, D2 and R13-R15 into PWR_EN
pass_limit: peak below the PCM's short-circuit trip at its delay, or the lockout's recovery written into assembly.md; PWR_EN stays below the ME6211's CE threshold through the edge
needs: the cell's PCM data (VER-37), 7d

title: Cell mating on unit 1: 10 plug-ins on the scope
procedure: no USB; scope on TP2 (VSYS) and TP6 (PWR_EN); plug a 4.2 V cell into J2 through the saver 10 times
pass_limit: VBAT present after every plug (no PCM lockout); PWR_EN stays low (the device stays off); VSYS peak <= 4.5 V

title: MLCC keep-out from the case's screw bosses
procedure: add to check_fit (or check_placement) with the hole list from case/positions.json and the boss radius from case.scad (boss_d + 1): every MLCC of 0603 or larger against every boss edge
pass_limit: 0 MLCCs within 3 mm of a boss edge (fails today on C9, about 0.9 mm from H3's boss); then C9 moved, or the risk accepted for EVT by Alex

title: Release run from a clean, tagged worktree (release.py)
procedure: write hardware/vv/tools/release.py: refuse a dirty tree; at the tagged commit run fab.py --no-pictures, check_bom_cpl, check_fab_content, the drill check and every scripted check; write evidence with the zip's sha256 and the KiCad, OpenSCAD and Python versions; fill the EVT release record
pass_limit: exits 0 at a clean tag; the record's sha256 equals the uploaded zip's; every scripted check's evidence names that commit

title: Dissipation per mode with positions; the firmware heat rule
procedure: a table per mode (off, cell play, USB play, charging, charging while playing) of each part's dissipation and position: U2 0.82 W (5.25 V in, 3.0 V cell) to 0.95 W (5.5 V, 2.9 V), U7 up to 0.54 W, Q5/Q6 about 0.26 W together, U3 about 0.2 W, D5 and R47 about 0.15 W; U2's junction at 50-60 C/W wetted and 100 C/W or more voided; from it a firmware rule written in pinmap.md (for example CHG_OFF or capped volume while the backlight is at full on USB)
pass_limit: the table written with each mode's total (about 2 W worst case, about 7 K mean rise); U2's junction below the TP4056's 120 C regulation point in a 40 C case when wetted; the firmware rule in pinmap.md before VER-86 runs

title: Charge timeout in firmware (the TP4056 has no timer)
procedure: a self-test build with the timers set to 60 s; USB in; (1) a real cell; (2) a 3.0 V bench supply with 10 ohm in parallel in its place
pass_limit: CHG_OFF high and CHG_STAT_N high within 60 +-5 s in both cases; a charge-fault screen until USB is re-plugged

title: D5 reverse leakage: per-unit TP1 screen and a warm-box check
procedure: per unit: cell in, no USB, device off, DMM on TP1 (about 1 mV per uA of D5 leakage across the roughly 0.94k on VBUS). Unit 2: an insulated box, a bulb and a thermometer at 45 C and 60 C, DMM across cut JP5
pass_limit: TP1 <= 20 mV at 25 C on every unit; at 45 C the JP5 current within REQ-PWR-07's 45 C limit; at 60 C TP1 < 0.3 V and PWR_EN low
needs: a warm box from household parts, 0d

title: Screw engagement in the lid's pilots
procedure: asserts in case.scad or check_fit.py: the screw tip from the counterbore depth, z_board, z_top_cu and the screw length bom.md names
pass_limit: engagement >= 4 mm and the tip >= 0.5 mm short of the pilot's end (M2 x 8 engages 1.4 mm today: fails; M2 x 11 engages 4.4 mm and ends 0.6 mm short)

title: Adjacent-pad bridge table (check_bridges.py, bridges.csv)
procedure: write board/tools/check_bridges.py: every pair of pads on different nets closer than 0.35 mm, from battler.kicad_pcb (pcbnew), against hardware/vv/bridges.csv, which classes each pair benign, caught by self-test, or dangerous with a DF row
pass_limit: exit 1 on any pair bridges.csv does not list (about 107 net pairs today); every dangerous pair names a DF row (U2 pin 5 to its EP: DF-106)

title: Generated REF-A pin file matches design.py
procedure: extend board/tools/pinmap.py to write crates/mega_blastoise_fw/src/board_ref_a.rs from design.GPIO and BOARD_REV (a const per net, the REV mask, the UART and SWD pins); a host test in scripts/check.sh fails when the committed file differs, or when the board_ref code uses a literal PIN_n
pass_limit: 0 differences; 0 literal pin numbers in board_ref code (today fw-ref-board a01f6fb reads the charger on PIN_41/42 and drives PIN_28-30 as a 74HC165: origin/main's map, DEF-34)

title: A minimal REF-A self-test builds for the ordered chip
procedure: add a board_ref_a feature with embassy-rp/rp235xb and memory-ref-a.x (FLASH LENGTH = 2048K); cargo build --no-default-features --features rp235xb,board_ref_a of a stub (UART hello, REV strap, button scan) in scripts/check.sh; save the llvm-size output
pass_limit: builds and links for rp235xb at 2048K; size recorded

title: The game image fits the RP2354B's 2 MB, with a flash map
procedure: llvm-size on the board_ref_a release build of the full game (both engines and the sprite blob); write a flash map (image, settings, battle log) into pinmap.md; a size check in scripts/check.sh
pass_limit: image <= the limit Alex sets (proposed 1.6 MB of 2 MB); flash map written

title: ESTIMATE ledger: case numbers that set copper are measured
procedure: write case/check_estimates.py: list every ESTIMATE variable in case.scad and follow it into the positions.json keys it changes; each copper-affecting one needs a measured value and an evidence file (calipers on the real cell plug, the panel's FPC, the DS Lite Start/Select membrane)
pass_limit: 0 copper-affecting ESTIMATEs without a measurement (about 12 marked today: plug_xs, fpc_neck, fpc_slack, ss_pitch, ss_mem among them); assembly.md's cell-hole size agrees with Edge.Cuts
needs: calipers (2d), cells (21d), the panel (10d), the DS Lite pad kit (owned)

title: Usable cell capacity per lot
procedure: one cell per lot: charge from the bench supply at 4.20 V with a 0.35 A limit (a CC/CV charger) until the current falls to 36 mA; discharge at about 140 mA through 27 ohm 2 W (or a ZB2L3-style tester), logging the voltage every minute
pass_limit: mAh to 3.50 V and to 3.60 V recorded; >= 600 mAh to the chosen cutoff (a proposal: Alex sets the lot limit); REQ-PRD-03.R recomputed from it
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d) and a 27 ohm 2 W resistor or a ZB2L3 tester (about $8, 14d)

title: Panel bond under press and heat
procedure: an EVT unit in its case: 20 N (kitchen scale) at the glass centre 100 times, then 24 h at 50 C in the warm box (VER-146)
pass_limit: the panel still bonded; no mura; no new contact marks on the panel's back; the tape's part number in the release record
needs: a kitchen scale (owned?), 0d

title: VBAT gain calibration per unit at 3.50 V
procedure: production test: no USB, the bench supply into J2 at 3.50 V, the self-test at its highest 3V3 load; a DMM checked that session against the 4.096 V reference; the firmware stores true / reading; record the raw ADC count, the DMM value and the gain in evidence/unit-<serial>.csv
pass_limit: gain within 0.95-1.05; a re-read at 3.50 V within 10 mV (as VBAT); the expected count computed from design.py's R17 and R18 at the released values
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference
needs: 4.096 V reference breakout (about $3, 7d)

title: No VBAT gain stored from a no-cell CHG_DONE_N edge
procedure: the self-test on USB with no cell for 5 min (CHG_STAT_N and CHG_DONE_N flicker, bringup.md 1.3)
pass_limit: no gain written; the stored production gain unchanged

title: Connector mating count per unit
procedure: count every mating of J2, J3, J5 and J6 in units.csv; bench pigtails through one PicoBlade saver that stays plugged; each rating confirmed in its maker's spec and written into j2.json and j3.json
pass_limit: no shipped unit past half its rated cycles on any connector; no unit used for FAI or abuse ships
needs: a spare PicoBlade pigtail pair for the saver (about $2, 7d)

title: Test access for every per-unit screen (check_test_access.py)
procedure: a probes table in bringup.md (the refs each step probes: TP1-TP16, JP1-JP5, C41's pads, R39, R48-R51, J2, J5, J6, J7, with the net each must sit on); write check_test_access.py, which imports design.py
pass_limit: exit 1 when a listed ref is missing, is no longer DNP or a test pad, or sits on another net than the table names

title: Back-power path table (check_backpower.py)
procedure: write board/tools/check_backpower.py over design.nets(): give each part a 'powered by' rail (U4, U6 and the panel on +3V3; U2 on VBUS; U7 on AMP_VDD); flag every net that joins an I/O of a +3V3 part to a source live when 3V3 is off (VBUS, VSYS, VBAT, CC1/CC2, USB_DP/DM, SWD, UART); each flagged path needs an entry with its worst-case current; seed DEF-01 by moving U1 pin 5 to VBUS
pass_limit: exit 1 on an unlisted path; today it flags R17/R18 (VBAT/2 into GPIO47), R3/R4 (CC into GPIO45/46 for about 1 ms at plug-in), R9/R10 (3V3 pull-ups into U2's CHRG and STDBY with VBUS at 0) and U1's REF; the seeded DEF-01 fails

title: Charge current and window tied to the cell (cell.json)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/board/cell.json (model, capacity, standard charge current, charge temperature range, PCM values) filled from VER-37; case.scad's cell numbers and a power-analysis script read it and assert
pass_limit: 1200 V / R5 <= min(0.5 C, the standard charge current); the TEMP window (VER-32) inside the cell's charge range; case.scad's cell size equals cell.json's
needs: the spec sheet (VER-37), 7d

title: Docs and the register quote the design's values (check_claims.py)
procedure: write tools/check_claims.py: extract '<ref> <value>' pairs (R21 22 ohm, R42 4.7k, R5 3.3k) and a table of (file, regex, source expression) from docs/*.md, README.md, PLAN.md, design.py's comments and hardware/vv/*.md and *.csv; compare with design.PARTS, case.scad and pin_review; list checks too (D7 in assembly.md's polarised list, Start not Y in bringup 6.2-6.3); run in the release run and scripts/check.sh
pass_limit: exit 1 on any mismatch; today it must find DEF-21 (b), (d), (e), (j) and part of (k)

title: Contact footprints as placed on battler.kicad_pcb
procedure: extract each SW footprint embedded in battler.kicad_pcb to a scratch .kicad_mod and run check_contact_fp.py on it (4ring with the 3.5 mm pill, 3ring with the measured Start/Select pill)
pass_limit: every placed contact passes as VER-08 and VER-09; 0 differences from the library file

title: Contact footprints as placed on prod_board.kicad_pcb
procedure: the same as VER-162 over hardware/prod_board/prod_board/prod_board.kicad_pcb, read only
pass_limit: every placed contact passes as VER-10

title: The cell rectangle: TH1's place and bare copper facing the pouch
procedure: add to check_fit (or check_placement) with positions.json's cell: TH1's distance from the cell centroid; bare copper (test pads, pogo pads, untented vias) on B.Cu inside the rectangle; a 1-D estimate of TH1's lag behind the cell through 1.6 mm of FR4 and the 0.45 mm foam (about 0.04 W/mK)
pass_limit: TH1 within 5 mm of the cell centroid (today 2.2 mm inside the long edge, about 15 mm from the centre: fails); 0 bare B.Cu pads inside the rectangle (today TP11-TP14: fails); the lag estimate and the copper decision (a B.Cu patch under TH1 with vias, or a silicone thermal pad for the foam) written before the order

title: Connector mouths and pinholes against the case (check_fit)
procedure: a mouth box per connector from its footprint orientation: J1 (a mated plug), J2 (the plug, 4.3 x 3.3 from plug_xs, plus the wire bend), J3 (the FPC's lead-in), J5 and J6 (a JST SH cable, 6 mm); the pinholes against the boss circles
pass_limit: nothing taller than 1 mm inside a mouth box; no box crosses a case wall except its own opening; no pinhole inside a boss circle

title: First-article sheet generated from design.py (fai_sheet.py)
procedure: write tools/fai_sheet.py: one row per BOM line (refs, value, LCSC, expected top marking from pin_review, polarity feature and its silk) plus the key dimensions (70.5 x 151.34 mm outline, 2.2 mm M2 holes, J1's face position, 4.8 mm comb mask) and the unpowered readings of VER-52 and VER-53; a second script refuses an incomplete sheet; sheets saved as evidence/FAI-<serial>.csv
pass_limit: the sheet covers every BOM line; the checker exits 1 on any blank result

title: Every contact class has a bought pill and cap (bom_coverage.py)
procedure: for each SW footprint class in design.py (4ring, 3ring) a row in bom.md's 'You' table naming its silicone piece and cap with a per-unit quantity (2 Start/Select strips, 4 caps); DSLITE.md holds the Start/Select cap and pill dimensions with a source
pass_limit: exit 1 otherwise (fails today: bom.md says the Start/Select strip is not used and buys no Start/Select caps: DEF-42)

title: Fault injection on the abuse unit (unit 4)
procedure: inject each DFMEA cause whose detection is credited (D7 and Q2 bridged, D6 lifted, R5 to GND, TEMP to GND, a comb shorted, a panel pin bridged) with the bench supply plus 10 ohm 5 W in place of the cell, never a real cell; run the credited detection; save evidence/fault_injection.csv
pass_limit: every credited detection trips; one that does not sends its row's D to 8 or 10 and the row back to H

title: Per-unit cell current with charging off
procedure: after VER-133 passes: a cell at about 3.8 V through the saver, DMM on its A range across cut JP5, USB in, CHG_OFF high from the self-test image; then the uA range
pass_limit: under 1 mA into the cell (D7 leakage, read on the uA range once the A range shows nothing); every unit
instrument: handheld DMM, A then uA range

title: ESD to IEC 61000-4-2 on the DVT spin
procedure: a borrowed or rented IEC 61000-4-2 gun: the comb pads first through the cap gaps, then the USB-C shell and the seams
pass_limit: +-4 kV contact and +-8 kV air: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle
needs: an IEC 61000-4-2 gun (borrow from a makerspace or rent), 14d

title: Golden-unit readings
procedure: after unit 1 passes FAI and every analysis limit: record its readings in evidence/golden.csv (TP1-TP7 unpowered resistances, TP3 with no cell, TP1 leakage, input current, TEMP ratio, backlight current, 3V3); at EVT exit replace them with the median of units 1-4; re-derive at DVT and PVT
pass_limit: the file exists for the phase; a reading outside the band (rail voltages 2%, currents 20%, resistances and leakage beyond 10x or below 0.1x) is a yellow note in units.csv and never changes a verdict or a limit

title: Bench charging rules kept
procedure: each unit's first charge uses the bench supply as the cell (0.5 A limit); a real cell charges only after VER-53, VER-133, VER-169 and VER-135 pass on that unit; every real-cell charge before VER-85 passes is attended, on a tile, in a LiPo bag, thermocouple on the cell, stop rule: above 50 C or any smell, unplug and close the bag
pass_limit: every unit's first real-cell charge recorded with unit, date and preconditions; 0 charges before them
needs: LiPo charging bag (about $8, 2d)

title: Case release record: STL hashes, material, slicer
procedure: fill the case section of the release record: the case.scad commit, sha256 of each exported STL or 3MF, material and brand, printer, slicer profile (layer height, walls, infill, the 100% modifier over J2), the panel tape's part number; emboss the case rev inside the tub
pass_limit: every field filled; VER-48 and VER-92 evidence names the hash

title: XY registration chain, pill to comb and cap to hole
procedure: write case/check_xy.py from case/positions.json and case.scad: every term of the chain (board in tub, deck, silicone, cap) with its tolerance, worst case and RSS
pass_limit: every pill centre within 0.9 mm of its comb centre at worst case
